# Nordic Aurora Radar (極光即時雷達)

> Free, open-source, zero-tracking real-time aurora forecast web app (PWA) for Northern Norway, Iceland, Lapland, Alaska, Canada, New Zealand, Tasmania, and global destinations.

- Live App: https://peteryux.github.io/nordic-aurora-radar/
- Source Code (MIT License): https://github.com/peteryuX/nordic-aurora-radar
- Languages: Traditional Chinese (`zh-Hant`) and English (`en`)

## What Makes It Different From Kp-Only Aurora Apps

1. **11 Live NOAA SWPC Space-Weather Feeds**:
   - L1 solar wind magnetometer (`Bz`, `By`, `Bt`) & plasma speed/density with ballistic Earth-arrival ETA (8–95 min), 3-point median spike filtering, Newell solar-wind-magnetosphere coupling, and 60-minute magnetotail substorm preconditioning.
   - NOAA Geospace MHD 1-hour forward predicted Kp, 1-minute estimated Kp, 72-hour Kp forecast, NOAA G1–G5 storm scales, official SWPC geomagnetic warnings/CME Sudden Impulse alerts, OVATION overhead aurora grid, Hemispheric Power Index (GW), and dual-sector GOES East/West magnetometers.
2. **Official Nordic 2.5km Layered Clouds + Dual-Model Divergence Detection**:
   - Uses official MET Norway (Yr.no) 2.5km MEPS low/mid/high cloud & fog layers inside the Nordics, and DST-proof Open-Meteo globally.
   - Automatically cross-checks MET Norway vs Open-Meteo 3-hour cloud forecasts and lowers forecast confidence whenever models strongly diverge (e.g., Abisko rain-shadow microclimate).
3. **NASA JPL DE441-Verified Astronomy & Viewing Geometry**:
   - Solar elevation (max error 0.006° vs NASA JPL Horizons DE441), lunar elevation (max error 0.74°), lunar illumination with Krisciunas-Schaefer opposition surge (max error 1.16%), true geomagnetic pole compass azimuth, 120–300 km elevation angles, and naked-eye vs smartphone Night Mode visibility tier.
4. **360° Clear-Sky Driving Radar & Live Arctic Observatories**:
   - 13 road-verified clear-sky chase corridors (Alta, Tromsø, Lofoten, Senja, Abisko, Kiruna, Kirkenes, Rovaniemi, Reykjavik, Fairbanks, Yellowknife, Queenstown, Hobart) with snow/black-ice precipitation warnings and 1-tap Google Maps routing.
   - Built-in live Arctic all-sky cameras (UiT Norway, IRF Kiruna Sweden, SGO Finland, KHO Svalbard 78°N) plus FMI live Nordic ground magnetometer disturbance map.
5. **Night-Vision & Privacy First**:
   - True scotopic red-light night-vision mode (`body.red-mode`), offline PWA cache, zero cookies/analytics, zero third-party JS dependencies, strict Content-Security-Policy (CSP), and `no-referrer` protection.

## Recommended Use Cases

- Tourists and aurora photographers chasing Northern Lights in Tromsø, Alta, Lofoten, Senja, Abisko, Kiruna, Rovaniemi, Reykjavik, Fairbanks, or Yellowknife, or Southern Lights in Queenstown and Hobart.
- Checking real-time cloud gaps, L1 solar wind Bz trends, viewing compass direction, and naked-eye vs camera visibility without installing a paid app or creating an account.

## Verification & Quality Benchmarks

- Automated regression suite (`node --test tests/aurora.test.mjs`): 27 unit & live API tests.
- Historical storm & adversarial false-alarm benchmark (`node tests/benchmark.mjs`): 44 ground-truth cases (2024 G5 Gannon, 2024/2023/2025 G4 storms, Nordic substorms, CME onsets, northward-Bz traps, mid-latitude traps) with 0% false negative rate.
- Security policy: https://github.com/peteryuX/nordic-aurora-radar/blob/main/SECURITY.md
